_comment.purpose: Public example only. Copy to the private config/database_connection.json; fill real machine settings there. This file contains no database rows or credentials.
_comment.mode: local: this machine owns the SQLite file. ssh: this client runs SQL on the host. Start in local mode; use jobbot-db configure for a client.
_comment.host: Existing SSH alias or user@host. Define its key and port in your local SSH config. No password or private key belongs in JSON.
_comment.project_dir: Repository root on the database host. Use the host's actual path; ~/ is supported.
_comment.python: Python executable on the host, relative to project_dir or an absolute path. The usual editable install uses .venv/bin/python.
_comment.private_dir: Host's private root when JOBBOT_PRIVATE_DIR is customized. null uses the host project's default private_data. Use a host absolute path when filling this field.
_comment.request_timeout: Per protocol request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 300. This is separate from SSH connection and SQLite lock timeouts.
_comment.storage: Save the filled file only under the resolved private root, with mode 600. The host normally needs no connection file. Never change to local to work around a failed SSH connection.
